description.en: Always up for a challenge and a fresh start, aries is full of energy and enthusiasm. With its great optimism and the concentration on the positive side, for this star sign everything is reachable. This pendant is available in 18 karat gold or sterling silver. Dimensions: approximately 21 x 15 x 2 mm.
